title: Junior Project Controls (00523)
description: The Junior Project Controls professional is responsible for supporting cost and schedule management functions across capital and operational projects. Works under close supervision to collect, analyze, and report cost, schedule, and progress data. Provides support in maintaining project forecasts, identifying trends, and assisting with reporting deliverables to project managers and clients. Cost Management Assists with implementing and maintaining cost control systems and procedures. Supports cost tracking efforts including budget, actuals, commitments, and forecasts. Prepares basic cost reports under guidance, identifying variances and trends. Gathers and integrates cost-related data from multiple stakeholders. Assists with reviewing contractor invoices and tracking change order impacts. Schedule Support Supports progress updates and schedule analysis using established tools and methods. Performs entry-level critical path reviews and “what-if” scenarios with guidance. Assists with monitoring schedule performance and identifying early indicators of delay. Coordinates with schedulers to align progress data with financial updates. Reporting & Documentation Prepares data for monthly cost and schedule reports. Assists with tracking and maintaining logs of RFIs, submittals, and other project documentation. Ensures data integrity in project controls systems and tools. Contributes to the development of visual and narrative report content for internal and external stakeholders. Collaboration & Communication Interfaces with project managers, engineers, contractors, and clients to gather cost and schedule inputs. Supports internal coordination between cost and scheduling teams. Communicates status updates clearly and timely to supervisors and team members. Other duties as assigned. Bachelor’s degree required, preferably in engineering, construction management, or finance. 0+ years of experience supporting cost, schedule, or project management efforts in a construction, engineering, or consulting environment preferred. Familiarity with project controls software such as Primavera P6, Microsoft Excel, and financial tracking tools preferred. Strong analytical and organizational skills with attention to detail. Ability to communicate technical information effectively to both technical and non-technical audiences. Desire to grow within the project controls discipline and develop long-term capabilities across cost, schedule, and risk functions.

title: Junior Scheduler / Project Controls Consultant
description: SOCOTEC is a provider of niche consulting services within the architecture, engineering and construction industries focusing on high-performance buildings and specialty structures. Through an integrated, holistic approach, our professionals provide solutions for building envelope, energy efficiency, sustainability, code advisory and construction advisory projects. SOCOTEC’s combination of expertise, experience and methods are increasingly recognized as best-in-class fueling significant growth. SOCOTEC offers competitive salary and benefits, mentorship, training, and social activities. SOCOTEC is proud to announce that it has been officially certified as a Great Place to Work by the renowned global authority on workplace culture, Great Place to Work®. We are seeking a Junior Scheduler / Project Controls Consultant to support our growing project advisory and construction consulting practice. This is an excellent opportunity for an early-career professional with hands-on experience developing and maintaining construction schedules who is looking to expand their capabilities in project controls, schedule analysis, and construction advisory. The successful candidate will ideally have approximately two years of experience working with a general contractor, construction manager, specialty contractor, or similar construction organization, with direct exposure to developing, updating, and managing construction schedules. The role will support projects across the building and infrastructure sectors and will work closely with senior schedulers, project controls professionals, project managers, and technical experts. Key Responsibilities Assist in the development, review, and maintenance of detailed construction project schedules. Develop and update Critical Path Method (CPM) schedules based on project scope, construction sequencing, and contractor work plans. Support preparation of baseline schedules, schedule updates, recovery schedules, and short-term look-ahead schedules. Review contractor schedule submissions for completeness, logic, sequencing, durations, and compliance with project requirements. Monitor project progress and incorporate actual progress into schedule updates. Identify critical and near-critical activities, schedule constraints, and potential impacts to project milestones. Assist with analysis of schedule variances and changes to the critical path. Work with project teams to collect schedule information, progress data, and supporting documentation. Assist in preparing schedule narratives, progress reports, schedule graphics, and management presentations. Support schedule impact assessments and preliminary delay analyses under the direction of senior scheduling and claims professionals. Assist with evaluating change orders and potential time impacts. Review project documentation, including drawings, specifications, contracts, progress reports, RFIs, submittals, and change documentation, to understand project sequencing and schedule impacts. Participate in project meetings and schedule review meetings with clients, contractors, designers, and other project stakeholders. Support broader project controls activities, including progress measurement, reporting, cost and schedule integration, and project performance analysis. Maintain clear and organized documentation supporting schedule updates and analyses. Bachelor’s degree in Civil Engineering, Construction Management, Construction Engineering, Architecture, or a related field. Approximately 2 or more years of relevant construction industry experience, preferably working for a general contractor, construction manager, or specialty contractor. Practical experience developing or maintaining construction schedules. Understanding of construction sequencing, project milestones, and the relationship between design, procurement, and construction activities. Basic understanding of Critical Path Method (CPM) scheduling principles. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. Strong written and verbal communication skills. Ability to organize and analyze project information and communicate findings clearly. Proficiency with Microsoft Excel, Word, and PowerPoint. Ability to work collaboratively as part of a multidisciplinary project team. Preferred Experience using Oracle Primavera P6. Experience with Microsoft Project or other scheduling/project controls software. Experience working on commercial buildings, healthcare, higher education, transportation, infrastructure, or other complex construction projects. Exposure to schedule review, delay analysis, change-order evaluation, or construction claims. Familiarity with construction drawings, specifications, contracts, and project documentation. Engineer-in-Training (EIT) certification or interest in pursuing professional certification is a plus. Ideal Candidate The ideal candidate has started their career working directly within the construction industry and understands how projects are actually planned and built. They have had hands-on exposure to construction scheduling and are interested in developing deeper expertise in project controls, schedule analysis, and construction advisory . This position is particularly well suited to someone who has spent the first few years of their career with a contractor or construction manager and is interested in transitioning into a consulting environment where they can work across multiple projects, clients, and construction sectors. What You Will Develop In this role, you will have the opportunity to develop expertise in: Advanced CPM scheduling Primavera P6 Construction schedule review and analysis Project controls and performance reporting Schedule risk and critical path analysis Change and delay analysis Construction claims and dispute support Project advisory and owner representation You will work alongside experienced construction, engineering, scheduling, and project controls professionals and gain exposure to complex projects from both the contractor and owner perspectives. For more information, please visit www.socotec.us Job Type: Full Time (4 days a week in office with one hybrid/ remote day) The position may be based in our Atlanta, New York, or Boston office. Some travel to project sites and client offices may be required depending on project assignments. All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines. SOCOTEC is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

title: Project Coordinator
description: About Us Sharpcontra is a forward-thinking organization dedicated to delivering impactful solutions with precision, innovation, and excellence. We believe in creating an environment where talent thrives, ideas matter, and every team member contributes to meaningful outcomes. Our culture is built on integrity, collaboration, and continuous improvement—ensuring that every project we undertake meets the highest standards of quality. title: 21GRAMS- Project Coordinator
location: Boston - Massachusetts; Carmel - Indiana; Chicago - Illinois; Lambertville - New Jersey; Remote - USA
description:
At Real Chemistry, making the world a healthier place isn’t just an aspiration—it’s our everyday reality. Our drive to transform healthcare is informed by our blend of deep scientific expertise, human-centred creativity, and AI-driven insights, fostering a unique environment where innovation thrives and our people are impact-obsessed. As a global agency, we provide a full suite of services across healthcare communications and marketing to our clients, including top players in the pharmaceutical and biotech industries.

Our #LifeatRealChem culture is rooted in our people—we believe we are best together and are committed to excellence for both our clients and colleagues. Whether you're a seasoned professional or just starting your career, if you share our passion for healthcare and connection, we invite you to explore our opportunities.

Discover your purpose. Embrace innovation. Experience #LifeatRealChem.

Real Chemistry is looking for a Project Coordinator to join our growing team!  

 

21GRAMS, part of Real Chemistry, takes an innovative approach to advertising, and focusing on making healthcare more human.  Not just in our work, but in the way we conduct business, approach client relationships, and treat each other. It’s a place where people subscribe to the adage, “Be good to each other, but hard on the work.” A place where people are not just in it for the paycheck, but to make a dent in the universe. Sound like you? 

 

The Project Coordinator is an entry-level role that supports the project management team in the delivery of integrated healthcare communications. This role builds core skills in scheduling, routing, documentation, and agency systems, and serves as the foundation for growth within the project management career path.

 

This is a hybrid role, based in any of our US offices—including New York City, Boston, Chicago, Carmel, Lambertville, or San Francisco—or remotely within the US, depending on team and business needs.

 

What you’ll do: 

• Support Project Managers with day-to-day task execution across multiple projects and brands.

• Maintain timelines, hot sheets, status reports, and project documentation with version control.

• Route deliverables through internal departments and track review cycles, including MLR and PRC submissions and returns.

• Assist in meeting preparation, capture detailed notes, distribute action items, and follow through on next steps.

• Open job codes, set up folders and Teams channels, and keep filing structures organized.

• Prepare small estimate requests and coordinate simple vendor engagements under guidance.

• Escalate risks, blockers, or quality issues to the project lead quickly and clearly.

 

Portfolio Management:

• Project-focused. No revenue oversight. No new business involvement.

Resource Management:

• No ownership of resourcing data or personnel communications.

• No Gantt ownership. Shadow staffing conversations to learn expectations.

Client and Vendor Relationship Management:

• Observer on client calls and email communications.

• Observer on vendor communications.

Training, Growth, Reporting:

• Establish professional attitude, self-motivation, and organization.

• Learn department onboarding checklists and reference documents.

Admin Operations:

• Learn Workfront routing, OpenAir and PowerBI basics, and timesheet review steps.

• Support day-to-day routing and traffic of jobs.

Execution:

• Update hot sheets and timelines. Send meeting notes and recaps.

• Learn project lifecycle and ask clarifying questions to build knowledge.

Finance:

• Open job codes. Pull basic reports for hours and OOPs.

• Create small-scale estimates for simple tactics under supervision.

Culture, Comms and Collaboration:

• Maintain a positive, can-do attitude and team mindset.

 

This position is a perfect fit for you if: 

  • ​Our Company values – Best Together, Impact-Obsessed, Excellence Expected, Evolve Always and Accountability with an “I” – really speak to you. 
  • You are adaptable, resilient, and OK with adjusting your scope, responsibilities, and focus as we grow. When things change, so do we. We’re always evolving. 
  • You are proactive, driven, and resourceful with strong prioritization skills and a desire to dive into the data. 
  • You are highly organized self-starter, able to work independently and under tight deadlines. 

 

What you should have:  

• Bachelor’s degree in business, communications, marketing, or related field preferred.

• Strong organization, time management, and attention to detail.

• Clear written and verbal communication skills.

• Proficiency with Microsoft 365. Familiarity with Workfront and Teams is a plus.

• 0 to 2 years in marketing or agency environments including internships.

• Demonstrated interest in healthcare communications and project management.

 

Pay Range: $55,000 - $65,000
This is the pay range the Company believes it will pay for this position at the time of this posting. Consistent with applicable law, compensation will be determined based on job-related, non-discriminatory factors including but not limited to work experience, skills, certifications, and geographical location. The Company reserves the right to modify this pay range at any time.

Some positions offer hybrid or remote flexibility, while others require regular in-office presence. For example, certain teams and regions, including some of our UK operations, have office-based requirements. Your recruiter will discuss the specific expectations for the role you're pursuing during the interview process and keep you informed throughout the hiring journey. For employees located within a one-hour commute of a Real Chemistry office, we require in-person attendance two days per week, either from a Real Chemistry office or when working onsite with clients. Employees in regions without a nearby office may work remotely and come together throughout the year for collaboration, culture-building, learning, and team connection opportunities. While these guidelines reflect our current workplace model, we understand that everyone’s circumstances are unique. title: Project Manager - Ports & Marine
description: Work with Us. Change the World. At AECOM, we're delivering a better world. Whether improving your commute, keeping the lights on, providing access to clean water, or transforming skylines, our work helps people and communities thrive. We are the world's trusted infrastructure consulting firm, partnering with clients to solve the world’s most complex challenges and build legacies for future generations. There has never been a better time to be at AECOM. With accelerating infrastructure investment worldwide, our services are in great demand. We invite you to bring your bold ideas and big dreams and become part of a global team of over 50,000 planners, designers, engineers, scientists, digital innovators, program and construction managers and other professionals delivering projects that create a positive and tangible impact around the world. We're one global team driven by our common purpose to deliver a better world. Join us. AECOM is actively seeking a highly experienced and motivated Project Manager for our Boston, MA office. The responsibilities of this position include, but are not limited to: Direct and manage the entire project lifecycle, providing guidance to subordinate managers, enforcing company and project policies, and serving as the primary liaison between AECOM and client interface. Ensure all project facets are constructed in accordance with design specifications, budget parameters, and established schedules. Maintain overall responsibility and management of projects from budgeting and scheduling phases through procurement and contract closeout. Exercise primary fiscal responsibility for assigned projects and serve as the key liaison with clients regarding financial and contractual matters. Develop and implement comprehensive project plans, including scope definition, resource allocation, timeline development, and risk identification and mitigation strategies. Monitor project performance against established key performance indicators (KPIs), quality standards, and contractual obligations, implementing corrective actions as needed. Manage change orders, scope modifications, and contract variations while maintaining project budget integrity and schedule adherence. Coordinate with vendors, subcontractors, and internal teams to ensure seamless project execution and timely delivery of deliverables. Prepare and present regular status reports, progress updates, and financial forecasts to senior management and clients. Minimum Qualifications: BA/BS plus ten years of relevant experience or demonstrated equivalency of experience and/or education. Preferred Qualifications: Previous experience in leading projects meeting required quality, timeliness, and budget parameters. Previous experience in maintaining client relationships. Experienced in planning, design, and construction management. Previous experience with Naval Facilities Engineering Systems Command (NAVFAC) planning and design. Sponsorship is not available for this position. Relocation assistance is not available for this position. At AECOM, we are committed to maintaining a secure and trustworthy recruitment process and take any fraudulent hiring activity seriously. To support this commitment, all newly hired employees are required to attend an in-person Day 1 onboarding at an AECOM office location as a condition of employment. About AECOM AECOM is proud to offer comprehensive benefits to meet the diverse needs of our employees. Depending on your employment status, AECOM benefits may include medical, dental, vision, life, AD&D, disability benefits, paid time off, leaves of absences, voluntary benefits, perks, flexible work options , well-being resources, employee assistance program, business travel insurance, service recognition awards, retirement savings plan, and employee stock purchase plan. AECOM is the global infrastructure leader, committed to delivering a better world. As a trusted professional services firm powered by deep technical abilities, we solve our clients’ complex challenges in water, environment, energy, transportation and buildings. Our teams partner with public- and private-sector clients to create innovative, sustainable and resilient solutions throughout the project lifecycle – from advisory, planning, design and engineering to program and construction management. AECOM is a Fortune 500 firm that had revenue of $16.1 billion in fiscal year 2025. Learn more at aecom.com. What makes AECOM a great place to work You will be part of a global team that champions your growth and career ambitions. Work on groundbreaking projects - both in your local community and on a global scale - that are transforming our industry and shaping the future. With cutting-edge technology and a network of experts, you’ll have the resources to make a real impact. Our award-winning training and development programs are designed to expand your technical expertise and leadership skills, helping you build the career you’ve always envisioned. Here, you’ll find a welcoming workplace built on respect, collaboration and community—where you have the freedom to grow in a world of opportunity. As an Equal Opportunity Employer, we believe in your potential and are here to help you achieve it. All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

title: Omni Channel Distribution & 3PL Operations Coordinator
description:
About Formlabs:

Do you want to change how the world creates?

At Formlabs, we’re building the tools that make it possible for anyone to bring their ideas to life, from cutting-edge products to life-saving medical devices. Our 3D printing technology powers innovation at more than 50,000 industry leaders worldwide, including Apple, Google, Tesla, New Balance, and NASA. Together, we’re helping everyone design, prototype, and manufacture faster than ever before.

We’re a team of hands-on builders, engineers, and innovators reinventing how the world makes physical things. If you’re ready to shape the future of fabrication, come build it with us.

Your Impact: Joining Formlabs as a Omni Channel Distribution & 3PL Operations Coordinator is a high-impact opportunity to be the final link in our global chain. You are the person who ensures the promise we make to our customers is kept. From resolving order sync errors to coordinating with regional carriers like FedEx and UPS, you make sure our printers leave the dock and reach the customer without friction. If you’re a proactive "figure-it-out" person who loves working in a fast-paced environment and wants to make a tangible impact on customer satisfaction, we want you on our team.

What You’ll Do:

  • Lead the daily monitoring of regional order flows, ensuring that all customer orders sync correctly between Shopify, NetSuite, and our 3PL warehouse management systems.
  • Oversee the resolution of order exceptions, such as address validation errors, inventory stockouts, or SKU mismatches, to prevent shipping delays and customer friction.
  • Direct the coordination of daily carrier pickups, working closely with warehouse staff and partners like FedEx, UPS, and DHL to ensure all "shippable" orders leave the dock on time.
  • Implement inventory reconciliation tasks by assisting in weekly cycle counts and investigating discrepancies between physical warehouse stock and digital records.
  • Collaborate with Customer Success teams to provide real-time updates on high-priority orders, transit delays, or regional delivery disruptions.
  • Drive shipping accuracy by auditing outbound packaging and documentation for regional compliance, ensuring all domestic and international labels meet carrier requirements.
  • Analyze daily fulfillment reports to identify "aging" orders that have exceeded our processing SLAs, escalating bottlenecks to the Senior Coordinator or Regional Head.
  • Support the execution of regional returns and "Reverse Logistics," ensuring that returned products are processed, inspected, and restocked or disposed of according to company policy.
  • Act as the primary point of contact for resolving sync errors, ensuring that 'stuck' orders are identified and cleared within 24 hours.

About You:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain or a related field; equivalent operational experience will also be considered.
  • Solid understanding of order-to-cash cycles and basic warehouse operations (receiving, put-away, picking, and shipping).
  • Exceptional organizational skills and the ability to multitask in a fast-paced environment where priorities can shift hourly.
  • Strong communication skills, with the ability to provide clear, concise updates to both internal teams and external 3PL partners.
  • A proactive, "figure-it-out" attitude with a commitment to high-quality execution and customer satisfaction.

Bonus Skills:

  • Basic proficiency in Excel for data entry and simple report generation.
  • Experience using Shopify, NetSuite, or common Warehouse Management Systems (WMS).
  • Familiarity with regional carrier networks and basic domestic shipping regulations.
  • Experience in a fulfillment, warehouse, or logistics coordination role, ideally within a high-growth e-commerce environment.

We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company.  We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.  

Even if you don't check every box, but see yourself contributing, please apply. Help us build an inclusive community that will change the face of 3D printing.

Compensation:

Equity is a big part of the compensation package at Formlabs - every employee receives equity because everyone contributes to building the company. We have a lot of confidence in the products we’re building and the impact we’re making, and you should too.

Base pay is the other part of our compensation package, and it is carefully determined based on your skills, experience, and expected impact. Equity and base pay combine to make up your total compensation package at Formlabs.

The annual base pay range for this role is:
$65,000—$75,000 USD

title: Project Manager, IPP
description:
New Leaf Energy is an experienced clean energy developer that partners with landowners, policymakers, and other stakeholders to accelerate the transition to a world powered by renewable energy. We identify high-value sites, work with landowners and local communities to develop them, and partner with long-term asset owners to bring the most impactful clean energy projects to life.

Position Summary 

The Project Manager, IPP (“PM”) is responsible for the day-to-day execution of projects during construction and commissioning. This role manages contractors, schedules, budgets, and site activities to ensure projects are executed safely, efficiently, and in alignment with approved plans. The PM operates within established cost, schedule, and technical frameworks and escalates risks, changes, and issues in accordance with the IPP’s organizational and governance structures.

Position responsibilities will include, but are not limited to: 

Project Execution

  • Lead day-to-day execution of assigned projects to commercial operation.
  • Serve as the IPP’s primary point of contact for EPC contractors, major suppliers, and third-party inspectors during construction, escalating commercial disputes or high-impact technical issues
  • Support commissioning, performance testing, and punch-list resolution.
  • Prepare and organize COD documentation and turnover materials.
  • Review EPC Contractor and vendor compliance with PWA, insurance, and other contract requirements
  • Identify and document contractor performance issues or contract deviations, escalating to senior leadership for formal notice preparation and resolution
  • Assist in organizing commissioning schedules, tracking punch-list items to completion, and compiling turnover documentation for the Asset Management team.

Schedule, Cost, and Reporting

  • Maintain and update detailed project schedules and construction plans.
  • Track weekly project expenditures against approved budget, update progress tracking models, and review contractor invoices against progress tracking models. 
  • Prepare accurate, timely project reports for senior leadership, lenders, and internal stakeholders.
  • Identify schedule and cost risks early and escalate with clear documentation and recommendations.

Change Management

  • Identify potential changes in scope, cost, or schedule and initiate change orders.
  • Coordinate technical evaluation with the Director of Engineering and commercial review with senior leadership.
  • Log potential change orders, collect backup documentation (cost estimates, schedule impacts) from contracts, and support senior management in reviewing change order packages. 
  • Implement approved changes and track execution impacts.

Quality, Safety and Compliance

  • Conduct routine site visits, safety observations, and progress verification.
  • Coordinate factory acceptance testing logistics, schedules, and documentation with vendors, EPCs, and Engineering.
  • Escalate safety incidents, near misses, and unsafe conditions.
  • Support incident investigations and corrective action implementation in coordination with senior leadership and contractors.

Desired Qualifications 

  • Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Construction Management, or related field.
  • At least three years of renewable energy construction or project management experience (IPP or EPC).
  • Strong understanding of construction sequencing, contractor management, and site safety.
  • Experience supporting change management and contract administration.
  • Excellent communication, organization, and escalation judgment.

 

Compensation

New Leaf Energy compensates all employees in three ways: market-competitive base salary, plus above-market variable compensation, plus an equity-like program such that all employees experience the benefits of ownership.  We use a data-driven and transparent methodology to calibrate compensation that is externally competitive and internally equitable, guided by the New Leaf Energy compensation manual, which is available to all employees.

Under our compensation framework, the likely base salary range for this position in the Boston location is $117,043 - 136,939. The on-target annual cash bonus associated with this position is an additional 10% percent of base salary. Your actual salary may be above, in, or below this range, depending on your location and experience.

We value transparency and can share more during the interview process.

 

Benefits and Culture

New Leaf Energy’s success is driven by our collaborative, long-term relationships based on trust and transparency. We offer a flexible work environment that places significant responsibility in independent teams and creates opportunities for innovation and personal growth. New Leaf Energy’s benefits are designed to appropriately recognize our employees’ contributions and enable a reasonable work/life balance. Our benefits include:

  • Competitive salaries and comprehensive benefits, including medical, dental and vision;
  • A 401k plan with immediate vesting and a company match (100% of the first three percent of your pay; 50% for the next two percent you contribute);
  • An open and self-managed paid time-off policy;
  • A hybrid work location policy that supports working from home for part of the week;
  • A parental leave policy for both birthing and non-birthing parents, available immediately upon hire;
  • Professional development and education assistance.

Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion

New Leaf Energy values the diverse perspectives, skills, experiences, and contributions of all employees. We want all our employees to feel like they belong and are empowered to be their most authentic selves at work. We’re actively committed to fostering diversity and creating an inclusive environment not only within our own organization but also within the clean energy industry.

We seek a diverse candidate pool in this–and every–search. New Leaf Energy provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants without regard to race, color, religion, gender, age, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, disability, genetics, veteran status or any other characteristic protected by state, federal and local laws. In addition to federal law requirements, New Leaf Energy complies with applicable state and local laws governing nondiscrimination in employment in every location in which the company has facilities. EEO M/F/D/V.

A Note to Third-Party Recruiters

New Leaf Energy’s People + Culture team coordinates all recruiting and hiring at our company. New Leaf Energy does not accept unsolicited resumes from third-party recruiters, staffing firms, or related agencies. Resumes are only accepted from third-party recruiters, staffing firms, or related agencies if a signed agreement is in place AND if external recruiting assistance is authorized by the People + Culture team for a specific position. All unsolicited resumes will be considered the property of New Leaf Energy. New Leaf Energy is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes.

This role manages contractors, schedules, budgets, and site activities to ensure projects are executed safely, efficiently, and in alignment with approved plans. The PM operates within established cost, schedule, and technical frameworks and escalates risks, changes, and issues in accordance with the IPP’s organizational and governance structures.

Position responsibilities will include, but are not limited to: 

Project Execution

  • Lead day-to-day execution of assigned projects to commercial operation.
  • Serve as the IPP’s primary point of contact for EPC contractors, major suppliers, and third-party inspectors during construction, escalating commercial disputes or high-impact technical issues
  • Support commissioning, performance testing, and punch-list resolution.
  • Prepare and organize COD documentation and turnover materials.
  • Review EPC Contractor and vendor compliance with PWA, insurance, and other contract requirements
  • Identify and document contractor performance issues or contract deviations, escalating to senior leadership for formal notice preparation and resolution
  • Assist in organizing commissioning schedules, tracking punch-list items to completion, and compiling turnover documentation for the Asset Management team.

Schedule, Cost, and Reporting

  • Maintain and update detailed project schedules and construction plans.
  • Track weekly project expenditures against approved budget, update progress tracking models, and review contractor invoices against progress tracking models. 
  • Prepare accurate, timely project reports for senior leadership, lenders, and internal stakeholders.
  • Identify schedule and cost risks early and escalate with clear documentation and recommendations.

Change Management

  • Identify potential changes in scope, cost, or schedule and initiate change orders.
  • Coordinate technical evaluation with the Director of Engineering and commercial review with senior leadership.
  • Log potential change orders, collect backup documentation (cost estimates, schedule impacts) from contracts, and support senior management in reviewing change order packages. 
  • Implement approved changes and track execution impacts.

Quality, Safety and Compliance

  • Conduct routine site visits, safety observations, and progress verification.
  • Coordinate factory acceptance testing logistics, schedules, and documentation with vendors, EPCs, and Engineering.
  • Escalate safety incidents, near misses, and unsafe conditions.
  • Support incident investigations and corrective action implementation in coordination with senior leadership and contractors.

Desired Qualifications 

  • Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Construction Management, or related field.
  • At least three years of renewable energy construction or project management experience (IPP or EPC).
  • Strong understanding of construction sequencing, contractor management, and site safety.
  • Experience supporting change management and contract administration.
  • Excellent communication, organization, and escalation judgment.

Compensation

New Leaf Energy compensates all employees in three ways: market-competitive base salary, plus above-market variable compensation, plus an equity-like program such that all employees experience the benefits of ownership.  We use a data-driven and transparent methodology to calibrate compensation that is externally competitive and internally equitable, guided by the New Leaf Energy compensation manual, which is available to all employees.

Under our compensation framework, the likely base salary range for this position in the Boston location is $117,043 - 136,939. The on-target annual cash bonus associated with this position is an additional 10% percent of base salary. Your actual salary may be above, in, or below this range, depending on your location and experience.

We value transparency and can share more during the interview process.

Benefits and Culture

New Leaf Energy’s success is driven by our collaborative, long-term relationships based on trust and transparency. We offer a flexible work environment that places significant responsibility in independent teams and creates opportunities for innovation and personal growth. New Leaf Energy’s benefits are designed to appropriately recognize our employees’ contributions and enable a reasonable work/life balance. Our benefits include:

  • Competitive salaries and comprehensive benefits, including medical, dental and vision;
  • A 401k plan with immediate vesting and a company match (100% of the first three percent of your pay; 50% for the next two percent you contribute);
  • An open and self-managed paid time-off policy;
  • A hybrid work location policy that supports working from home for part of the week;
  • A parental leave policy for both birthing and non-birthing parents, available immediately upon hire;
  • Professional development and education assistance.

Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion

New Leaf Energy values the diverse perspectives, skills, experiences, and contributions of all employees. We want all our employees to feel like they belong and are empowered to be their most authentic selves at work. We’re actively committed to fostering diversity and creating an inclusive environment not only within our own organization but also within the clean energy industry.

We seek a diverse candidate pool in this–and every–search. New Leaf Energy provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants without regard to race, color, religion, gender, age, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, disability, genetics, veteran status or any other characteristic protected by state, federal and local laws. In addition to federal law requirements, New Leaf Energy complies with applicable state and local laws governing nondiscrimination in employment in every location in which the company has facilities. EEO M/F/D/V.

A Note to Third-Party Recruiters

New Leaf Energy’s People + Culture team coordinates all recruiting and hiring at our company. New Leaf Energy does not accept unsolicited resumes from third-party recruiters, staffing firms, or related agencies. Resumes are only accepted from third-party recruiters, staffing firms, or related agencies if a signed agreement is in place AND if external recruiting assistance is authorized by the People + Culture team for a specific position. All unsolicited resumes will be considered the property of New Leaf Energy. New Leaf Energy is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes.

title: Strategy & Operations Analyst
description:
Join Formlabs if you want to bring ground-breaking professional 3D printers to the desktop of every designer, engineer, researcher, and artist in the world.

As a Strategy & Operations Analyst at Formlabs, you will turn messy business problems into shipped solutions. You’ll take problem statements from teams across the company — Finance, Operations, Sales, Support, R&D — scope them, rally the right people, and build much of the solution yourself with SQL, Python, automation, and AI tools. You’ll also be a key partner to the CIO in running the IT & Systems organization: driving OKRs, reporting, and roadmapping across a 26-person team spanning data platform, digital systems, financial systems, infrastructure, and cybersecurity.

This is a role for someone early in their career with a very strong ability to learn quickly — someone who has done analytical or operations work at a consulting firm, startup, or BizOps team, and who would rather build the fix than write the deck about it.

You will report directly to the CIO and work closely with the leaders of each IT & Systems team.

This role is based in our Somerville, MA office and will be a hybrid role with the expectation of at least 3 days a week in office.

The Job:

  • Business Problem Delivery: Take ambiguous problem statements from the business, define requirements and success measures, and lead small cross-functional teams from scoping through launch.
  • Hands-On Building: Write the SQL queries, Python scripts, integrations, and low-code or AI-powered automations that close gaps between systems — then hand off steady-state ownership to the right domain team.
  • OKRs & Planning: Run the IT & Systems OKR process — gather inputs, track progress, and surface risks early so leadership can make decisions.
  • Reporting & Roadmaps: Own the data, cadence, and first draft of recurring leadership reporting, roadmap rollups, and spend reporting (cloud, SaaS, and AI tools).
  • Operational Excellence: Improve how the organization runs — software purchasing, renewals, license hygiene, and vendor coordination — with a bias toward automating the process rather than doing it by hand.
  • Executive Support: Prepare analysis and materials for executive and cross-functional discussions, translating technical work into business outcomes.

You:

  • Experience: 2–4 years in consulting, business operations, strategy & operations, or a similar analytical role.
  • MBA: From a top-tier program (or equivalent strategic experience in fast-paced, high-growth companies)
  • Builder Mindset: Have shipped something real that other people used — a tool, dashboard, automation, or script — not just a spreadsheet model.
  • Technical Skills: Comfortable writing SQL and working in Python or a similar scripting language; able to learn new systems and APIs quickly.
  • Structured Thinking: Can break down an ambiguous problem, size it, and communicate a clear recommendation in writing and in person.
  • Cross-Functional Influence: Lead without authority — you build trust with engineers, finance partners, and business stakeholders alike.
  • Ownership: Highly organized, follow through on commitments, and are comfortable juggling several workstreams at once.
  • Bachelor’s degree in engineering, computer science, economics, business, or a related field.

Bonus Points:

  • Experience using AI tools (e.g., Claude, agentic workflows) to automate business processes.
  • Exposure to enterprise systems such as NetSuite, Salesforce, Shopify, or a modern data stack (dbt, BigQuery, Snowflake, or similar).
  • Experience running an OKR, planning, or budgeting process.
  • Familiarity with software procurement, vendor management, or SaaS spend management.
  • Interest in hardware, manufacturing, or 3D printing.

Our Perks & Benefits:

  • Robust equity program to build future wealth through RSUs
  • Comprehensive healthcare coverage (Medical, Dental, Vision)
  • Low cost fund options in our 401K and access to advisors
  • Generous paid Parental Leave (up to 16 weeks)
  • Tenure-based paid Sabbatical Leave (up to 6 weeks)
  • Flexible Out of Office Plan – Take time when you need it
  • Ample free on-site parking & pre-tax commuter benefits
  • Healthy on-site lunches, snacks, beverages, & treats
  • Regular sponsored professional development opportunities
  • Many opt-in culture events across our diverse community
  • And of course… unlimited 3D prints

We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

Even if you don’t check every box, but see yourself contributing, please apply. Help us build an inclusive community that will change the face of 3D printing.

Compensation:

Equity is a big part of the compensation package at Formlabs - every employee receives equity because everyone contributes to building the company. We have a lot of confidence in the products we’re building and the impact we’re making, and you should too.

Base pay is the other part of our compensation package, and it is carefully determined based on your skills, experience, and expected impact. Equity and base pay combine to make up your total compensation package at Formlabs.

The annual base pay range for this role is:
$85,000—$140,000 USD

title: Mechanical Project Manager
description:
About Formlabs:

A 3D printer is one of the most demanding machines you can build.

Lasers, optics, precision motion, thermals, airflow, materials handling, chemistry, sensing, controls, and software all have to work at micron-scale precision, for thousands of layers, with almost no tolerance for error. Making that work reliably is an extraordinary engineering problem.

That’s what we do.

At Formlabs, we’re building 3D printers that are changing the way things get made. We have the smartest minds across every engineering discipline, and the technology they’re building is deployed at more than 50,000 industry leaders worldwide, including Apple, Google, Tesla, New Balance, and NASA.

Your Impact: 

The Mechanical Project Manager makes sure our prototyping and development process is efficient and executed firmly. At Formlabs we’re constantly iterating on our products and building new prototypes. As the engineering project manager you’ll work with the mechanical engineering team and the engineering team broadly to bring these prototypes to life and once they’re built to make sure they’re being maintained and used effectively. You’ll also work closely with the mechanical engineering team to support the complexities of developing hardware such as managing BOMs, inventory and product configurations. This is a role that benefits from energizing your peers and has high visibility as your results are our highly coveted prototype products.

What You’ll Do:

  • Be the glue to pull disparate teams together to hit key milestones and goals through the product development process
  • Manage (in conjunction with the G$ team) the Bill of Materials for our products making sure it is up to date and usable for ordering, cost analysis and useful for tracking development status.
  • Push ECOs through the release process and make sure they’re implemented in a controlled manner.
  • Develop spaces for builds including workspace, tools, shelving for inventory and finished goods
  • Manage inventory for prototype and integration builds including receiving parts, managing incoming quality control, stocking parts and prepping for builds.
  • Make sure that prototype builds happen smoothly and as quickly as possible. Run daily standups or other methods of work tracking and motivation to make sure builds remain unblocked. 
  • Organize and plan work. Motivate team members. Track progress and issues. Communicate with stakeholders and close out issues.
  • Manage the configuration of our fleet of prototype printers. Maintain an up to date inventory of prototype printers, their configuration, status and use. Ensure that reworks and retrofits happen quickly and successfully.
  • Improve processes across mechanical engineering to support the smooth development of products
  • Broadly support the mechanical engineering team and mechanical engineering manager as project manager embedded in that team

About You:

  • Demonstrates motivation to bring amazing products to life by pushing yourself, your peers and the development process forward
  • Consistent and organized to make sure we’re doing everything we can to succeed
  • Ready to get your hands dirty filling gaps and leading by example
  • Can jump between organizing data to organizing people and back during the course of a day
  • A working knowledge of technical documentation and the desire to keep learning in this area
  • Build bridges between team leads and key doers on teams to quickly solve problems and blockages

Bonus Skills: 

  • Depth in mechanical engineering, electrical engineering or integration software
  • Data analysis and spreadsheet wizardry
  • Experience with PLM systems

Our Perks & Benefits:

  • Unlimited 3D printing with any Formlabs material on any Formlabs printer
  • An equity program that will let you build wealth through RSUs
  • Healthcare coverage (medical, dental, vision) that includes a totally free employee-only plan, effective starting on your first day on the job
  • 401K matching with no vesting or tenure requirement
  • Generous parental leave (fully paid up to 16 weeks)
  • Flexible time off so you can take time when you need it
  • Six-week fully paid sabbatical after hitting tenure milestones (with the option to take an additional six weeks after that)
  • Free on-site parking & pre-tax commuter benefits
  • Free on-site lunch, snacks, beverages, treats, beer kegs, and employee-favorite local coffee and espresso
  • Self-driven professional development opportunities like conferences, trade shows, and hackathons
  • One-of-a-kind activities and events like monthly socials, the annual weekend summer camp, a can’t-miss company hackathon, and lots of other social opportunities

You don’t need to check every box to apply for a role. If you love working with hardware, spending time with smart people, solving hard problems, and winning, we want to hear from you.

Our Candidate AI Guidelines are available here. Please give them a read.

Compensation:

Equity is a big part of the compensation package at Formlabs - every employee receives equity because everyone contributes to building the company. We have a lot of confidence in the products we’re building and the impact we’re making, and you should too.

Base pay is the other part of our compensation package, and it is carefully determined based on your skills, experience, and expected impact. Equity and base pay combine to make up your total compensation package at Formlabs.

The annual base pay range for this role is:
$90,000—$120,000 USD

title: Project Engineer
description:
COMPANY DESCRIPTION: 

A career here is life-enhancing.

At Syner-G, we enable our people to build careers that impact positively on their quality of life. Through our expertise, insight, consulting and management skills, we accelerate breakthrough science and delivery of life-enhancing therapies to more patients. We work across a diverse range of clients and projects, supporting many organizations from the most critical phases of the drug discovery and approval process through to commercialization. It is meaningful, varied and thought-provoking work with a strategic emphasis, a solutions-driven approach and significant, real-world outcomes, from science to delivery/success. To learn more about who we are and what drives us, watch our company video here. 

Underpinning this mission is a culture that aligns perfectly with what we want to achieve. We enable our people to grow, we support them in their learning and we reward them in so many different ways. In return, they play an instrumental role in maintaining our reputation across the globe as a strategic biopharma product development and delivery partner.

Syner-G was recently honored with BioSpace's prestigious "Best Places to Work" 2026 award, for the third consecutive year, along with many other award-winning programs to make a career here truly life-enhancing. These recognitions are a testament to our commitment to fostering a positive and engaging work environment for our employees, with a particular emphasis on culture, career growth and development opportunities, financial rewards, leadership and innovation. 

At Syner-G, we recognize that our team members are our most valuable asset. Join us in shaping the future, where your talents are valued, and your contributions make a meaningful impact. 

For more information, visit www.Synergbiopharma.com

POSITION OVERVIEW:

Syner-G is seeking a Project Engineer to support the technical planning, coordination, and execution of capital projects across facility, infrastructure, and construction initiatives. This role provides engineering support, field coordination, technical documentation management, and problem-solving to ensure capital projects are delivered safely, efficiently, and in alignment with program objectives. The Project Engineer works closely with project managers, construction teams, design engineers, procurement, operations, and client stakeholders to support design reviews, technical evaluations, field activities, and project controls. We are actively seeking qualified candidates to join our talent pipeline for future client engagements.

WORK LOCATION:

Travel to client sites may be required based on project demands and client expectations.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:

(This list is not exhaustive and may be supplemented or adjusted as necessary.)

  • Support engineering and technical activities across capital projects, ensuring alignment with project requirements, design intent, and construction execution plans.
  • Assist with reviewing design drawings, specifications, submittals, RFIs, and technical documentation for accuracy and compliance.
  • Support field engineering activities including site walks, construction coordination, equipment verification, and issue resolution.
  • Help maintain project schedules by tracking engineering deliverables, construction progress, and technical dependencies.
  • Assist with project controls activities such as cost tracking, quantity verification, procurement coordination, and change documentation.
  • Coordinate with design firms, contractors, vendors, and internal teams to ensure timely resolution of technical questions and issues.
  • Prepare engineering logs, meeting minutes, action items, and technical reports.
  • Support commissioning and turnover activities including punch list development, equipment testing coordination, and documentation review.
  • Assist with risk identification, issue tracking, and mitigation planning.
  • Ensure project activities comply with applicable codes, standards, and internal procedures.
  • Support development of project documentation including work plans, technical summaries, and engineering packages.
  • Provide general engineering and project support to project managers and senior engineers.

QUALIFICATIONS AND REQUIREMENTS:

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements below represent the education, experience, skills, knowledge, and abilities required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

Education:

  • Bachelor’s degree in engineering (mechanical, electrical, chemical, civil, industrial, or related discipline) required.
  • EIT certification or progress toward licensure is a plus.

Technical Experience:

  • 1–3 years of experience supporting capital projects, construction projects, facility upgrades, or engineering design efforts.
  • Experience working in regulated or complex environments such as biotech, pharmaceutical, industrial, or advanced manufacturing is preferred.
  • Familiarity with engineering design processes, construction coordination, technical documentation, and field engineering activities.
  • Experience collaborating with design engineers, construction teams, procurement, operations, and safety personnel.
  • Exposure to project phases such as design development, procurement, construction, commissioning, or turnover is beneficial.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities:

  • Strong technical and analytical skills with the ability to interpret engineering drawings, specifications, and technical documents.
  • Proficiency with engineering and project management tools, CAD viewers, and standard office software.
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills with the ability to collaborate across diverse teams.
  • Highly organized with strong attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple tasks simultaneously.
  • Ability to work in fast-paced environments and adapt to shifting priorities.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to support field issue resolution.
  • Ability to build strong working relationships with clients, contractors, and cross-functional partners.

 

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS:

Physical Demands: 

The physical demands described here are representative of the requirements that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. 

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to use a computer keyboard and mouse; reach with hands and arms; talk and listen. The employee is frequently required to walk and sit, as well as to lift and carry objects such as books and files weighing up to 25 pounds. The employee is occasionally required to stand, stoop, or kneel. Specific vision abilities required by this position include close vision and the ability to adjust focus. 

Work Environment: 

The work environment characteristics described here are representative of those an employee encounters while performing the essential functions of this job, including moderate noise level, an indoor temperate environment, and light levels that are bright and conducive to minimal eye strain, typical for an office environment. 

TOTAL REWARDS PROGRAM:

We define total rewards as compensation, benefits, remote work/flexibility, development, recognition, and our culture with programs that support each of our reward pillars. This includes a market competitive base salary and annual incentive plan, robust benefit offerings, and ongoing recognition and career development opportunities. Employees also enjoy our generous flexible paid time off program, company-paid holidays, flexible working hours, and fully remote work options for most positions and the ability to work “almost anywhere.” However, if a physical work location is more for you, we have office locations in Greater Boston; San Diego, CA; Boulder, CO; and India.

Currently, Syner-G is unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment Visa at this time. 

LEGAL STATEMENT:
 
Syner-G is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer. All employment decisions, including the recruiting, hiring, placement, training availability, promotion, compensation, evaluation, disciplinary actions, and termination of employment (if necessary) are made without regard to the employee’s race, color, creed, religion, sex, pregnancy or childbirth, personal appearance, family responsibilities, sexual orientation or preference, gender identity, political affiliation, source of income, place of residence, national or ethnic origin, ancestry, age, marital status, military veteran status, unfavorable discharge from military service, physical or mental disability, or on any other basis prohibited by applicable law. Syner-G is an E-Verify employer.

title: Risk & Compliance Project Manager
description:
The Risk and Compliance Project Manager will be responsible for managing projects in Risk and Compliance and Cybersecurity teams to drive compliance and cybersecurity initiatives across the entire organization.

ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS/RESPONSIBILITIES

Managing projects:

  • Manage project scope, including identification of key activities linked to compliance and cybersecurity requirements
  • Manage the project timeline and project costs/resources
  • Manage project risks, assumptions, issues and dependencies
  • Leverage approved Artificial Intelligence (AI) tools and technologies to improve project planning, reporting, risk analysis, documentation, stakeholder communications, and overall project delivery efficiency.
  • Identify opportunities to apply AI-enabled solutions to compliance, cybersecurity, risk management, and project management processes while ensuring alignment with organizational policies, security requirements, and regulatory obligations.
  • Adhere to agreed project governance, steering, and change control processes
  • Produce regular project reports and management updates
  • Create and maintain project schedules and plans, and manage project tasks using standard InterSystems tools (AI tools, MS Project, MS Office, Atlassian JIRA and Confluence)
  • Lead lessons learned activities and proactively implement lessons learned to new initiatives

General strategies for compliance project management:

  • Promote the effective use of AI technologies to enhance project outcomes, support data-driven decision making, and improve operational efficiency across Risk, Compliance, Cybersecurity, and Clinical Safety initiatives.
  • Lead compliance improvement projects to ensure the consistent development and implementation of interdepartmental and cross-functional team projects
  • Apply InterSystems project and change management principles to project management and lead initiatives for continued improvements
  • Lead in the management and maintenance of a strong change control process throughout the duration of projects
  • Lead planning sessions to facilitate production of plans and deliverables

Demonstrate thorough skills and abilities the provision of support to the Cybersecurity, Risk & Compliance and Clinical Safety teams and their objectives:

  • Manage the completion of all tasks, including those of any third party partner according to the timeline
  • Maintain focus on efficiency while managing the project time and costs/resources
  • Provide advice and best practices to project team members
  • Work proactively and collaboratively with other team members to achieve team goals and establish a culture of success and learning within the team

Perform other related duties and activities as required.
